description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/flux_limiter_superbee_D_inflow_bc driven by problems/advection_1d_inflow_superbee.esm (model AdvectionSuperbeeInflow), loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) -- no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured steady solution cos(pi x) is held by the exact forcing c dGdx with left inflow gL = u*(0) = 1 (derivation and the inflow/outflow-compatibility argument in the problem file). cos(pi x) is smooth and monotone on [0,1], so the superbee limiter is INACTIVE in the interior (second-order there), and the boundary faces -- though a FORMALLY first-order closure (the prescribed inflow flux gL, the extrapolated outflow) -- carry only higher-order residuals for THIS compatible MMS because the exact inflow value is supplied and the wall gradient u*_x is zero at both walls. The OBSERVED order is therefore close to the design second order and norm-dependent: the Julia golden gives pairwise L2 orders [2.11, 2.23, 2.19] (median 2.19 -- slightly ABOVE 2, the classic mild steepening of the compressive superbee limiter on smooth data) and Linf [1.67, 1.92, 1.99] (median 1.92) over N=16..128. expected_order 2.0 with order_tolerance 0.25 brackets both norm medians; the numbers are read from the Julia sweep, not forced.
